title: The merge writer fetches and pushes with a fine-grained token over HTTPS
description: A scratch bare repository is served over token-authenticated git smart HTTP on loopback (git http-backend behind a Basic-auth server): an install configured with the token fetches and pushes a merge through it, a wrong token is refused, the token appears in no log line, and an install with a deploy key still uses origin.

steps.name: merge writer token over smart HTTP
